messages:
maya: Quick async on dedicated GPU handoff — 8x H100 nodes arriving next week. Need confirmations: who owns AMI baking, k8s nodepool config, canary reservations, and who will be on-site for rack power tests. tagging SRE/infra.

sam: I can own AMI baking + container image tagging. ETA Tue for a first smoke image. What driver/kernel combo do we want pinned?

leo: Driver guidance from vendor: NVIDIA 535 + CUDA 12.2. Host kernel 6.1 recommended. Also confirm firmware versions; I'll sync with colo for firmware updates.

anya: SRE: we can run rack power tests Thu 10:00-12:00. Who has physical access at the colo? @infra-oncall?

infra-oncall: I have access and will be onsite Thu. I'll validate PDU strips, PDUs labeled, and run power sequencing. Please list any power draw tests you want.

maya: For reservations: product requested 3 guaranteed nodes in a "canary" group, autoscale up to 8 for peak. @sam can you create a nodepool named `dedicated-canary` with appropriate taints/labels? Also need an SLA doc for the 3 reserved nodes.

sam: Yep. Plan: create nodepool with taint `dedicated=canary:NoSchedule` and label `redwood/dedicated=true`. I'll prepare k8s YAML + cluster API PR. Will include autoscaler config for burst to 8. PR ETA: EOD Wed.

leo: Networking note: we need a VIP in 10.40.0.0/24 and SR-IOV enabled for the NICs to guarantee bandwidth. @networking-team please advise on SR-IOV VLANs and MTU.

sre-oncall: Observability checklist: log forwarding to ELK, trace sampling for canaries, error alerting. We also need token redaction in logs before enabling shipping. Send a sample log format.

maya: Owner check — who's taking the canary rollout playbook? I want a short runbook for failure modes: driver mismatch, node flakiness, network misconfigs, and fallback to hosted pool.

anya: I'll draft the canary playbook and runbook and drop it in #eng-oncall by EOD Fri. Will include rollback steps and smoke test commands.

sam: I'll include AMI bake steps and smoke test commands in the PR, tagging @maya and @anya for review.

maya: Small internal checklist I'm tracking:
- hardware racked + PDUs validated
- drivers and AMI baked
- k8s nodepool with taints/labels + autoscaler
- VIP + SR-IOV network config
- canary reservation policy (3 reserved)
- observability + token redaction
- playbook + rollback steps
Who wants to be listed as on-call for the first 48h post-launch?

leo: I'll take first 24h on-call for infra-level issues.

infra-oncall: I can cover hardware/network for first 48h on rotational basis.

maya: Thanks — updated timeline: if driver QA passes and AMI smoke tests are green, target soft-announce Mon (unix ts: 1790376000). If anything slips, we push one day.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] dedicated-canary nodepool PR merged by sam at 1790312400

maya: Noted. If all runs green in QA, tentative live target Tue (unix ts: 1790390000). Will update calendar + handoff doc. :thumbsup:
